Short answers up front: 1) During the SOC 2 Type II period (2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31) Redwood did not operate "EU-only" dedicated host pools under the "EU-only" offering; production traffic for some customers was served from EU regions via partner cloud regions starting in Jan 2026, but the audited environment referenced in the report reflects our global hosted control plane and controls across our production fleet. 2) We can provide a bridge letter that attests to control continuity and our data handling commitments for the period between the report end and your expected go-live. 3) Customer-managed KMS keys used by EU customers are tenant-scoped and, by design, never exported to non-EU key stores; operational access follows strict role-based controls.

I'm attaching the SOC 2 report PDF and will draft a bridge letter — looping in Marissa and Neha who own SOC2 evidence & partner hosting ops. - We circulate a draft bridge letter for review by Tue 2026-10-05

Hi Martin — Marissa on the trust & compliance team here. Thanks for the specifics; we prepared a short draft bridge letter that addresses both bullets and includes a short subprocessor disclosure for the Jan–Mar 2026 routing window. Key points in the draft:

- Transfer mechanism: Redwood will rely on standard contractual clauses (SCCs) between Redwood and its EU cloud partner for cross-border transfers on behalf of customers when applicable; we will sign an EU addendum to the DPA specifying SCCs upon contract execution.
- Backups/KMS: We confirm that EuroFin production backups and customer-managed KMS key references for EU customers were not replicated to or accessible from non-EU datacenters during the SOC 2 Type II coverage window. Operational logs and key access records for the period are available as evidence upon NDA.
- Subprocessors: During Jan–Mar 2026, traffic routing leveraged PartnerCloud-EU (a named partner). PartnerCloud-EU’s processing occurred within EU regions; PartnerCloud-EU maintains its own subprocessors — a short disclosure list is in the draft.

Draft attached — please review and let us know any legal language edits. If that looks good we can get the letter signed and provide the supporting evidence links.

Regards,
